label: Experimental Lake Simcoe — unvalidated depth-averaged wind response
componentOrientation: true east / true north in local equirectangular approximation
averagingMethod: Trapezoidal time integral of east/north components, every solver step, over2026-10-12T00:00:00Z–2026-10-17T12:00:00Z; meanSpeed separately retained.

method.equations: Linearized rotating shallow-water equations with variable undisturbed depth, nonlinear quadratic bottom drag, surface wind stress; no advective or thermal/density terms.
method.scheme: Arakawa C-grid finite volume, depth-weighted skew-symmetric corner Coriolis, SSP-RK3
method.initialCondition: Rest with eta0=0 at2026-10-01T05:00:00Z;259.0-hour wind-forced spinup before mean window.
method.boundary: No-normal-flow on all land/island faces and closed Atherley Narrows; no tributary/outlet forcing.
method.averaging: Trapezoidal time integral of east/north components, every solver step, over2026-10-12T00:00:00Z–2026-10-17T12:00:00Z; meanSpeed separately retained.

wind.name: ECCC National Climate Archive — Barrie-Oro hourly observations

rawUnits.WIND_DIRECTION: tens of degrees true, meteorological direction from

assumptions: Land-station wind applied uniformly to the lake; no over-water speed correction.
Nominal 10m wind height is assumed from the ECCC standard; a station-specific anemometer-height record was not verified.
Hourly observations are short-period observation averages, not hourly-mean winds; the samples are linearly interpolated in time.
UTC_DATE is used directly as UTC. LOCAL_DATE is EST throughout the source record, with no daylight-saving adjustment.
Wind forcing is not a measurement of water current.

bathymetry.purpose: Bathymetric grid for an experimental unvalidated depth-averaged wind-response calculation; not current measurements.

projection.name: local spherical equirectangular
projection.maxLocalScaleErrorNote: Longitude metric uses cos44.45N throughout this approximately 50km domain.

contours.depth: DEPTH negative metres below source survey water reference, negated to positive H; exact survey vertical reference is not specified in individual contour fields. This model uses depth, not an absolute lake elevation.
contours.accuracy: Source LOCATION_ACCURACY varies; inspect cached records. Historic hand-digitized contours include Within 10 metres.

shoreline.source: OpenStreetMap contributors / OpenFreeMap / OpenMapTiles, inherited from existing map geography
shoreline.processing: Cell centres in the true Simcoe polygon only; island holes retained. Faces between wet and dry cells are closed. Atherley Narrows connection is closed at the polygon/grid boundary.

interpolation.method: Linear Delaunay interpolation of contour vertices thinned to150m plus zero-depth shoreline and island vertices; nearest fallback only for wet sites outside triangulation.
interpolation.noFlowBoundary: All wet/dry faces; tributaries and Atherley exchange excluded.

limitations: 1957 historical contours are not a modern full-bottom survey.
500m cells cannot resolve narrow channels or all small islands.
Coastal minimum depth1m regularizes interpolated very shallow cells.
No velocity calibration or validation is supplied by bathymetry.
Experimental physics response, not observed/retrieved/validated currents.
Depth average cannot represent actual surface shear, thermal stratification, internal waves or baroclinic circulation.
Single land weather station applied uniformly, no over-water correction; nominal10m wind height assumed, not station-verified.
Closed narrows, no tributaries or outlet throughflow; avoid interpreting channel currents.
Historic interpolated bathymetry and 500m grid; unresolved small-scale coast and channels.
Constant uncertain bottom and air-water drag; numerical tests do not establish field accuracy.
The averaging window is the2026week, not a multiyear October climatology.
